description: BUILD MODE (2026-09-09): construction todos distilled from imagination output (Braid final dream + HER's 6-iteration self-imagination). HER does the work autonomously; human only reloads servers / copies screenshots / gives direction. Underlying systems now begin construction.
imagined_system_model: ONE braid core (append-only Merkle-DAG ledger + capability policy + audit loom) exposing ONE wire protocol + ONE UI bridge, consumed by THREE doors: door1 = lumen/axiom read views (witness + structure of the same DAG), door2 = godmode (full-creative terminal), door3 = quest3d spatial walk-in. Atomic braided triplets (token + policy snapshot + audit pre-commitment) are the substrate's core invariant. Speculative fourth strand (intent) is out of build scope until triplets are proven.

Wire grew Tail {since_cid,limit} and Inspect ops — the ledger's last N committed nodes with prev links (cursor-driven for --follow) and the single-head invariant (real heads=1, forks=0 computed off the log) + every registered door's view position + the frozen snapshot. Frontdoor added Tail/Inspect arms (read-gated like every read; unknown since_cid = honest denial); Shell grew Tail/Inspect/Prove/Policy keyless routes + query string parsing; walk_in.html header gained the inspect panel (heads/forks/depth live via /inspect poll).
